schema-snapshot.removalGate: Remove only after AI/schema tooling and signed internal callers are retired with replacement evidence.

ai-ops.removalGate: Remove only after the signed AI operations command path and its audit/idempotency contract are explicitly retired.

ai-chat-exec.removalGate: Remove only after all signed chat-to-ai-ops adapter callers have replacement evidence.

schema-snapshot-cron.removalGate: Do not infer dead code from the lack of a frontend caller. Retire only after scheduler/integration evidence proves the signed snapshot adapter is unused.

mailer-invite.removalGate: Retain while Users or Platform Control can issue member invitations.

admin-users.removalGate: Retain while authenticated admin user synchronization remains in the application.

mailer-report.removalGate: The maintained email worker matrix classifies this endpoint as dormant but retained. Delete only under an explicit report-email retirement package with template and audit evidence.

due-reminder-worker.removalGate: Retain while due-reminder queue processing or scheduler invocation exists. verify_jwt=false is paired with the worker secret gate and must not be treated as anonymous business access.

digest-worker.removalGate: Retain while daily digest queue processing or scheduler invocation exists. verify_jwt=false is paired with the worker secret gate and must not be treated as anonymous business access.

mailer-company-access.removalGate: Retain while Platform Control can send governed company-access communications.

email-template-lab.removalGate: QA-only and fail-closed by default. Remove only after its regression/template evidence is replaced and no authorised QA workflow depends on it.
